notes: Six-engine results are a fresh sequential run. All earlier measurement directories are unchanged.

GFM is not equal output: Inkmark omits www.example.com autolinking and serializes tables differently.
Supplemental workloads are generated by prepare.py as bench-scanners.json and bench-references.json.
Allocation diagnostics count calls and cumulative requested bytes, not peak or retained memory; arena traversal excludes construction.
33f9c0f changes arena ownership conversion to handle End events normally; direct HTML production code is unchanged from 7ed5e9d.

simd-ab.json.notes: Scalar-equivalent scanner implementation versus memchr-assisted searches before subsequent correctness fixes. Three alternating pairs; not final-source timings. The scalar executable came from an experimental source snapshot equivalent to the named scanner revision, not a final-source rebuild.

progress-ab.json.notes: Separate sequential release binaries. The compact checkpoint has the same rollback correctness as the full Point checkpoint. Inter-run variation is material.

ascii-label-ab.json.notes: Both include the reference-space correctness fix. Reference-heavy benefit is repeatable in these pairs; mixed-document gain is not established.
